title: Passkey confirmation binding
description: The JSON part of the binding passkey_binding returns: the text is "basalt-passkey-confirm.1\n" followed by this object's jsonb text exactly as Postgres prints it. The WebAuthn challenge is sha256 of the whole text's UTF-8 bytes. Clients parse it for display and never re-serialise it. Vectors: confirm-vectors.json. CONTRACT.md, Access and audit, People and passkeys.

credentialId.description: The waiting passkey's credential id, base64url.

fingerprint.description: Passkey fingerprint: Crockford base32 of the first 10 bytes of sha256("basalt-passkey-fp.1\n" || credentialId || x || y), four groups of four joined by '-'. CONTRACT.md, Access and audit, People and passkeys.

personName.description: The person's display name: 1 to 64 characters, no control characters.

level.description: ADMIN, or an enrolled role (ROLE, named by roleOid and roleName).

roleOid.description: The enrolled role's oid; null for ADMIN.

roleName.description: The enrolled role's name at the time; null for ADMIN.

registeredAt.description: RFC 3339 UTC with six fraction digits and Z.

expiresAt.description: RFC 3339 UTC with six fraction digits and Z, 7 days after registeredAt.
